title: System Settings
subtitle: Global community settings (upload/review/registration)
manualReviewEnabledHint: Published videos enter the review queue before visible
registerEnabledHint: When off, new users cannot self-register in the app
allowedVideoTypesHint: Comma-separated extensions, e.g. mp4, mov, webm
allowedVideoTypesRequired: At least one video type is required
sensitiveFilterEnabledHint: When on: publishes hitting words go to review, comments are rejected
sensitiveWordsHint: One word per line (or comma-separated), effective on save
announcementEnabledHint: Show an announcement banner at the top of the app home (empty text hides it)
announcementTextHint: Content shown in the banner on the app home
announcementLinkHint: Optional; opened when the banner is tapped (http/https)
danmakuEnabledHint: When off, the app hides the danmaku layer and rejects sending (existing danmaku hidden)
imEnabledHint: When off, sending messages is rejected (existing conversations stay readable)
